title: Autopsy and Letter
author: Vesper Galloway
blurb: Tamsin Yarrow, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
